{{Short description|None}}
The '''Sammarinese records in swimming''' are the fastest ever performances of swimmers from [[San Marino]], which are recognised and ratified by the [[Federazione Sammarinese Nuoto|San Marino Swimming Federation]] (FSN).

All records were set in finals unless noted otherwise.

==Long Course (50 m)==
===Men===
